messages:
Ava: deploy-bot just flagged p95 spike on embeddings after v4.0.0 rollout to us-east-1. auto-action: fallback to v3.x or full rollback. tagging @Tom and @Lina.

deploy-bot: ALERT — embeddings-service us-east-1 p95 +40% vs baseline in last 5m. Suggested: 1) route hosted traffic to model=v3-stable for 10m 2) manual rollback to v3.9.8. Confidence=high. https://telemetry/redwood/embeddings/us-east-1

Tom: quick scan: increased tail due to kv-eviction + new matmul kernels on long sequences. Dedicated pools pinned to v4.0.0 — avoid touching them if possible.

Lina: ops: scoped fallback to hosted-only is fine. Approve if oncall (Tom) agrees. Comms: add console banner and internal note.

Tom: oncall approves. ops-runner you have green.

ops-runner: running command now: redwood route set --service embeddings-service --region us-east-1 --scope hosted --model v3-stable --percent 100 --duration 10m --reason "p95 mitigation". RunID=rb-3642001234-01

deploy-bot: ACTION LOG — route applied. RunID=rb-3642001234-01

Ava: metrics improving, p95 trending back to baseline. Leaving fallback for 10m and monitoring. Lina please post the banner.

Lina: banner up: "Temporary mitigation: hosted embeddings traffic in us-east-1 routed to v3-stable while we investigate. Expected follow-up within 2 hours."

Tom: eng-ml to root-cause; if issue persists after TTL we will schedule rollback with release-note and customer comms.

Ava: noted. thanks everyone.
